maddeler.e: بَلْطَجِيّ • (balṭajiyy) m (plural بَلَاطِجَة (balāṭija) or بَلْطَجِيُّون (balṭajiyyūn), feminine بَلْطَجِيَّة (balṭajiyya))
maddeler.t: From the dialects of the eastern Mediterranean, including Egyptian Arabic بلطجي (balṭagi, “thug”), from Ottoman Turkish بالطهجی (baltacı, literally “axeman”). Related to Arabic بَلْطَة (balṭa).
